name: Physical Energy
body:
When the force of your personality is exhausted, you can tap into your bodily reserves to fuel your spirit connection.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage, rage or raging song class feature; rapture class feature.

Benefit(s): You may spend rounds of bloodrage, rage, or raging song as rounds of rapture, and vice versa. You can choose to use any spirit abilities or rage powers you possess with either ability, but the effects of both only depend on your level in the class that grants the feature.
